parameters.query:
SELECT t.id AS ticket_id, t.ticket_code, t.customer_id, t.status AS ticket_status, t.category, t.channel,
       c.full_name AS customer_name, c.email AS customer_email, c.telegram_id AS customer_telegram_id,
       s.full_name AS staff_name, s.role AS staff_role
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.id = {{ $('Code - Chuẩn hóa thông tin phản hồi').item.json.staff_id || 4 }}
WHERE t.id = {{ $('Code - Chuẩn hóa thông tin phản hồi').item.json.ticket_id }};
